verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own registered-agent service: it lists its address on public records, handles RA-switch paperwork and state fees, and updates the Secretary of State. However, nothing in the evidence states that this service is available in every US state, which is the core of the story, so only the existence of the service is shown, not its coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit all-50-states (plus DC) coverage claim, evidence that one account can cover entities registered in multiple states, and independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-state coverage.
